description: Bande de 5km à partir du trait de côte en Bretagne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Bande des 5km créée à partir du trait de côte sur la région Bretagne Basée sur la donnée "Limite Terre-Mer du SHOM". Coverage: Région Bretagne. The publisher named on the listing is Région Bretagne. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, cote, 233500016, inspire, hydrographie, bretagne. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
